```{r import-packages}
#| echo: false
library(here)
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
library(naniar)

source(here("util", "helpers.R"))
```


```{r data-read}
# -------- Whoop Sleep --------

# Load cleaned sleep data
# Tidy_Sleep_Data.Rmd must be run first to generate this file
sleep_data <- readRDS(here("data", "cleaned_sleep_data.rds"))

# -------- Whoop Recovery --------
# load Robin's properly cleaned recovery data
# Tidy_Recovery_Data.Rmd must be run first to generate this file
recovery_data <- readRDS(here("data", "cleaned_recovery_data.rds"))

# -------- Whoop Cycle --------
# sanitize structure first so columns are usable
cycle_data <- readRDS(here("data", "cleaned_cycle_data.rds"))

```


# Data joining
```{r data-joining}
whoop_master <- cycle_data %>%
  inner_join( sleep_data, by = c("id" = "cycle_id")
  ) %>%
  inner_join(recovery_data, by = c("id" = "cycle_id")
  )
```

```{r}
whoop_cycles_no_sleep <- cycle_data %>% 
  left_join(sleep_data, by = c("id" = "cycle_id")) %>%
  filter(is.na(sleep_duration))
```

```{r}
write_rds(whoop_master, here("data", "whoop_master.rds"))
```
